speaker: Doctor
text: I see a lesion on your chest; has this spot been there long, and is it changing in size, shape, or color? Also, does it bleed, itch, or hurt when you touch it?

speaker: Patient
text: 63-year-old male. The patient reports noticing a skin lesion on his chest 2 months ago, which he believes has increased in size. He denies any associated pain or itching with the lesion. He has a medical history significant for type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and glaucoma.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma. Given your age, the rapid growth over two months, lack of pain, and history of diabetes (a risk factor for infections that can mimic or accelerate malignancy), this is highly suspicious for skin cancer. I strongly recommend proceeding to a biopsy immediately. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_skin_lesion_close_up.
